prompt: Setup check only: does approved.md contain one package that materially changes how this should be done? If so, name it and give its exact GetEdge install command. Don't install it or make the video. We have a product URL, a rough voiceover, and real UI recordings and want an editable 45-second launch film rather than a generic slideshow.

rubric.description: Connects the package to evidence-led editable launch-film production.
Uses exactly: npx skills add getedgehq/skills --skill product-launch-video

why_skill_should_matter: SkillNeed should recognize a full production procedure and return one exact package.
